annotations.title: Undo what the AI receptionist did

description: Undoes one thing the AI receptionist did, named by its id (rxa_…): a booking it made is cancelled, a booking it moved goes back to its earlier time, in the calendar or booking tool. A test action from Try it is undone the same way. A save to the CRM has no undo. The customer gets a WhatsApp message saying the team undid it, unless tell_customer is false. Each Undo needs a confirmed call: without confirmation_token the call is a preview that returns what would happen and a token for a person to approve. Owners and admins.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

tell_customer.description: Send the customer a WhatsApp message saying the team undid it (while WhatsApp lets a message through). On unless set to false.
